## Instagram Reel caption, option A (story)

## Instagram Reel caption, option B (fact first)
20,000 km upar se 4 satellites tumhe dhoondh lete hain 🛰️📍
Aur traffic? Wo tumhare jaise laakhon phones batate hain 🚗📱
Berlin mein ek banda 99 phones thele mein le gaya... aur Google Maps ne khaali sadak laal kar di 😂
Offline map pehle download karo, GPS bina internet bhi chalta hai ✅
